factor_specs.economic_rationale_full: High-dim cross-sectional ML alpha. Kelly-Malamud-Zhou 2024 'Virtue of Complexity in Return Prediction' (JF forthcoming, working paper SSRN 4501336, §4.2 Theorem 2) — 1,044 features with ridge-like regularization in ensemble produces stable cross-section ranking that classical 4-5 factor composites cannot capture. Rank-average of 5 base models (Ridge / LASSO / Elastic Net / XGBoost GPU / LightGBM) ensures single-model overfitting diversification — bias-variance dampening operationalized as model-space ensemble. Validation > Discovery (7 Modern Trends P1 SOT). Trend P2 cost-aware variant M7_XGB_CostAware kept as PARALLEL gamma-regularized variant (gamma=0.001), NOT absorbed into ensemble — M7 selection happens at Phase 1 design before lockbox eval. PIT-clean mandate universe (KOSPI200∪KOSDAQ150 + t-1 ADV20 ≥ 2e8) M6 vs M5 vs M7 comparison shows M6 dominates Pareto: IC ≈ M7 (0.041 vs 0.043) but Q5 mono perfect (1.00 vs 0.70), and M5 collapses (ICIR 1.082 full-panel → 0.223 mandate universe). Trend P3 uncertainty discount (Liao 2025 RFS) NOT applied — Confident-High-Low lockbox delta -0.166 FAIL, KR microstructure misalignment, Phase 2 revisit planned.
